info.name: Bantay Presyo API
info.description: Market prices of basic goods in the Philippines, compared against DTI suggested retail prices (SRP).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Accounts and tokens. Tokens are sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and expire after 30 days. New accounts get a verification email and must verify before submitting price reports.

request.description:
Always responds the same way so it can't be used to check which emails are registered.
The emailed link points to `FRONTEND_URL/reset-password?token=...&email=...`.
Logs the user out of every device.

Target of the signed link in the verification email. Submitting price reports
requires a verified email.

response.body: {"error":{"code":"forbidden","message":"You are not allowed to perform this action.","details":null}}

item.name: Commodities
item.description: Basic goods tracked by the monitor, with price trends and SRP comparison.

query.description: Start date (inclusive). Defaults to 29 days before `to`. Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d.
End date (inclusive). Defaults to today. Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d.
Only count reports from this market. Must match an existing stored value.

request.description: Average, minimum and maximum reported price per day. Defaults to the last 30 days.

query.description: Size of the averaging window in days, ending today. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 90.
Only count reports from this market. Must match an existing stored value.

request.description: Average reported price over the last `days` days (default 7) against the SRP in effect today.

item.name: Markets
item.description: Public markets where prices are reported.

item.name: SRPs
item.description: DTI suggested retail prices. The SRP in effect is the one with the latest effective date on or before today.

formdata.description: Used for rows without an `effective_date`. Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d.

request.description:
Upload a CSV with a header row. Rows are matched to commodities by name (and `unit` if given).
An existing SRP for the same commodity and date is updated. If any row is invalid, nothing is imported
and every bad row is listed in `error.details.file`. See `docs/srp-import-example.csv`.

item.name: Price reports
item.description: Prices seen at a market on a given day, submitted by registered users.

query.description: Earliest report date (inclusive). Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d.
Latest report date (inclusive). Must be a valid date in the format Y-m-d.
Max 100. Must be at least 1. Must not be greater than 100.
Only reports more than 30% above the SRP in effect (1) or only the rest (0).
Admins only. Include reports hidden by moderators.

request.description: Newest first. Reports hidden by moderators are left out.

Requires a verified email. `reported_at` defaults to now and cannot be in the future.
Reports more than 30% above the SRP in effect at `reported_at` come back with `flagged: true`.
Limited to 10 reports a minute and 200 a day per user.
